name: Edward J. Stack
summary:
Edward John Stack (April 29, 1910 – November 3, 1989) was a member of the United States House of Representatives from Florida.

Born in Bayonne, New Jersey, to Irish immigrants, Stack attended the public schools and received a B.A. from Lehigh University in Bethlehem, Pennsylvania, in 1931. He went on to earn a J.D. from the University of Pennsylvania Law School in 1934 and a M.A. in public law and government from Columbia University in 1938.
